title: Release v1.38.0 (mint floor: 20% equal / 10% work / 70% stake)
summary: THIS UPGRADE HALTS THE CHAIN. Every validator must be running v1.38.0 when the plan height is reached. Mint distribution changes shape: today 25% of each interval is stake-weighted and 75% is weighted by relay credits multiplied by stake, which makes the work pool a second stake pool and leaves a small validator earning a rounding error for the same hosting work. From v1.38.0 each interval splits three ways: 20% paid equally to every bonded, non-jailed validator, 10% weighted by capped relay credits alone, and the remaining 70% weighted by stake. The upgrade handler writes mint_floor_split = 0.20 and mint_dynamic_split = 0.10; the new mint_floor_split param (field 55) does not exist before this binary, which is why this cannot be a param-change proposal. mint_quantity and mint_interval are unchanged. This is a consensus change: a node still on v1.37.0 computes a different allocation from the same block, so mixed binaries would fork on the first mint interval after the halt. Jailed and unbonded validators remain excluded.
